# Agatha Sowerby & Nell Harcourt

- _previously:_ [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) — Enemy of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) (until v1)  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P31](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0031)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Agatha Sowerby visits [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and rudely mocks Nell's plain appearance and red hair. Enraged by the insult, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) flies into a violent temper and shouts at Mrs. Sowerby before storming off to her room. After Mrs. Sowerby leaves in offense, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) goes upstairs to lecture [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and demands that she apologize, though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stubbornly refuses.
>

> [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) secretly visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in her room and convinces her to apologize to Mrs. Sowerby. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) agrees, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) accompanies her to Mrs. Sowerby's house, where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) delivers a dramatic and humble apology. Mrs. Sowerby forgives her and offers her hope about her hair, and on the walk home, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares her imaginative thoughts with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), expressing her joy at feeling at home at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P49](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0049)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) presents [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with three simple dresses and refuses her request for fashionable puffed sleeves, sending her off to study Sunday school materials. The next morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) decorates her hat with flowers and attends Sunday school alone when [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) falls ill. Upon returning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) candidly recounts her experiences at church, including her dislike of her plain dress compared to the other girls' puffed sleeves and her impression of the service.
>

Nell’s Impressions of Sunday-school P21](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0021)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) reprimands [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for wearing flowers on her hat to church, then takes her to [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md). The two young girls quickly bond and swear to be best friends forever before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home. Back at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) gives [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chocolates, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) admits to him that she is growing fond of the girl.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P0](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XII. > In class, [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her red hair, prompting her to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Pidgeon](../character/pidgeon.md) punishes [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) by forcing her to stand at the front of the room and later making her sit beside Hugh, leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to declare that she will never return to school. Upon returning home, [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) seeks advice from [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), who recommends letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper subsides.
>

> Following Agatha's advice, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) decides not to force [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back to school, allowing her to study at home instead. Though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) stubbornly refuses to forgive [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), she grows deeply attached to Isolde. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) later finds [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) weeping dramatically over the imagined future heartbreak of Isolde marrying and leaving her, which moves [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to rare, genuine laughter.
>

> Isolde leaves [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) unwell, and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) later discovers [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) mistakenly served three-year-old currant wine instead of raspberry cordial. After learning Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) blames [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for getting Isolde drunk, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) visits [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill) to clear up the mistake but is rebuffed. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) then confronts Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) herself to beg for forgiveness, but Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) coldly turns her away.
>

> While [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Sowerby attend a political rally in town, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) spend a quiet evening at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md) rushes in to ask for help when her baby sister, [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md), contracts croup while their parents are away. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) uses her experience to treat [Posy Fay](../character/posy-fay.md) through the night until a doctor arrives, saving the child's life before returning home to rest.
>

> After learning that [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) was furious over the bed-jumping incident and planned to leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) takes full responsibility for the prank. She goes into the parlor to apologize directly to [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), successfully winning over the strict old woman with her honesty and charm. [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) decides to stay, forgives Isolde, and develops a fond friendship with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives an invitation to tea at the manse from Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md), which excites her greatly despite Thirza's attempts to temper her emotions. After attending tea with another girl named [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) Bradley, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) joyfully reports back to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) about her wonderful evening, Mrs. Wace's kindness, and news that a female teacher named Miss [Agnes](../codex/places.md#agnes) [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) has been hired for the local school.
>

> [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) notices how poorly [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) dresses compared to her friends and decides to buy her a stylish new gown for [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas). After an awkward attempt to shop by himself at [Samuel](../character/samuel.md) Lawson's store in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford), he enlists Mrs. Sowerby's help to buy the fabric and sew the dress with fashionable puffed sleeves. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives the gown at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and is overwhelmed with joy and gratitude.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) returns to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) expecting tea, only to find the kitchen cold and empty. She discovers [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) hiding in her room, distraught because she dyed her red hair green with a peddler's dye. After washing fails to remove the dye, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) cuts Nell's hair extremely short, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) must face school with her cropped head.
>

> At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) offered to include her in a special class to prepare for the Regent's entrance exam. Excited by the chance to train as a teacher, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accepts and joins the class alongside her peers, though she mourns that Isolde will not be participating with her.
>

> At school, Hugh silently competes with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) while ignoring her, leaving her to regret her past harshness as the term ends. Miss [Thorne](../character/thorne.md) reassures the class that she will return next year, prompting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to happily lock away her books for summer vacation. Later, [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) visits [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and compliments Nell's growth and grace despite her initial misgivings.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) enjoys a relaxing, healthy summer after a doctor advises outdoor play to preserve her health. Returning to her studies in autumn, she works hard under Miss Thorne's guidance to prepare for the upcoming Entrance examination despite her growing anxieties. As she physically matures and reflects on her changes, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) experiences a bittersweet realization of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) growing up.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) completes her entrance examinations in town, staying with [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md), and returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) to anxiously await the results. After weeks of tense waiting, Isolde brings the newspaper showing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) tied for first place on the island. Overjoyed, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares the glorious news with [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and Mrs. Sowerby.
>

She receives their proud congratulations before ending her night with a heartfelt prayer of thanks.

> [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) collapses and dies after receiving news of the bank failure, plunging [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) into mourning. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) grieves with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and converses with Mrs. [Wace](../character/wace.md) about life carrying on despite her loss. As routine returns, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat on the porch about friends, future plans, and Thirza's past romance.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) returns from the eye doctor with bad news that her vision is severely failing and she must avoid eye strain, prompting her to consider selling [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) insists on giving up her college scholarship to stay home, care for [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and teach locally so they can keep their home. Later, Mrs. Sowerby reveals that [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) selflessly withdrew his application for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) school so [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) could teach there, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) thanks Hugh when she runs into him.
>

> Mrs. Sowerby remarks to [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) that [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) has mellowed. After visiting Obed's grave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) on the hill and thanks him for stepping aside for the school position, leading the two former foes to reconcile and become friends. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and later reflects contentedly at her window on her future path.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) is day-dreaming while studying when Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) angrily confronts her about her cow escaping into his oat field again. After he leaves in a huff, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) locks the cow away and later discusses the incident and local gossip with [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Agatha Sowerby over tea.
>

> Mrs. Sowerby visits [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), gossiping about recent incidents and the influx of newcomers to the area. She questions [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her proposed Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and cautions her against pursuing it, while also mentioning that Nell's acquaintance, [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), will be teaching at [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford).
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P50](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0050), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057)_

> On their way back from shopping in [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde chase a Jersey cow out of a neighbor's oat field, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) impulsively sells the cow to Mr. [Shearer](../character/shearer.md). Upon returning home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discovers her own cow is still in the pen, realizing she mistakenly sold Mr. Pettifer's cow instead. Resigned to face his temper, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) packs a freshly baked nut cake as a peace offering and sets off to confess her mistake to Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md).
>
> — v2 · II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P41](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0041), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P42](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0042)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), and Hugh discuss their differing views on classroom discipline before beginning their upcoming teaching terms. Afterward, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), avoiding Mrs. Sowerby to instead converse with Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) about her plan to rule her school with affection. The next morning, a nervous [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) shares her anxieties over breakfast with [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).
>
> — v2 · IV Different Opinions

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007), [v2 IV Different Opinions P27](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0027), [v2 IV Different Opinions P41](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0041)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) brings the newly orphaned twins, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), back to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) proves to be extremely energetic and prone to mischief, including dropping a caterpillar down Lauretta's dress during church. During a meeting of the [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society) at the house, a dripping-wet [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) bursts into the dining room after [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) entices her outside.
>
> — v2 · VIII Thirza Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) debate Mrs. Sowerby's character and discuss the Improvement Society's progress on fixing up the hall. Later, Mrs. Sowerby and the youths discover that [Joshua Tulk](../character/joshua-tulk.md) painted the hall bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with paint order numbers. Despite the catastrophic outcome, the community rallies behind the [Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) and blames the [Tulks](../codex/factions.md#tulks) for the mistake.
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) discuss Robin's habit of lying and punish him by sending him to bed without dinner. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) in his room, where he tries to argue that [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) lied about the consequences of skipping prayers. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defends [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), and after going downstairs, she and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) discuss Robin's mischievous behavior and how best to raise him.
>

> Suffering from a toothache, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) loses her temper at school, accidentally causing firecrackers to detonate in the stove and later whipping [Anthony Tulk](../character/anthony-tulk.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Devastated by her loss of composure, she confides in [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) at home. The next morning, Anthony surprisingly shows respect for her actions, which is later confirmed by [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md).
>

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036)_

> Mrs. Sowerby chats with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about church bazaar plans before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes home to discuss family letters with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and handle Robin's comedic mischief. Later, at a B.V.I.S. meeting, [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md) reveals that [Judson Tibbs](../character/judson-tibbs.md) plans to rent his farm fence for commercial ads, sparking panic among the members.
>

> During lunch, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) accidentally knocks down and smashes Miss Pembroke's platter, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) deeply apologetic. After the guests leave, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a letter from [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stating their visit is canceled. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) sit together outdoors, discussing the day's mishaps, life's disappointments, and local rumors as Hugh approaches.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) puts [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed after helping him settle his worries about her feelings compared to [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md). Later, she meets [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) near the Nymph's Well, where they talk about community improvements and mutual friends before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to plan her tasks with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md).
>

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) depart for town, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) at home. While transferring feathers, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally applies rug dye to her nose, but Isolde helps her wash it off before they host [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), Mrs. [Varley](../character/varley.md), and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for dinner and a stroll.
>

> A stylish older woman arrives at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) looking for [James A](../character/james-a.md). [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) and reveals to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that she is his long-estranged wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md). The news quickly spreads through the village, and when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), she finds his house freshly cleaned and learns that he is secretly glad to have his wife back.
>

> Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) explains to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) the history of his marriage, his quarrel over his parrot [Nutmeg](../character/nutmeg.md), and his eventual reconciliation with [Emily](../character/emily.md). Later, Mrs. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) expresses her gratitude over the paper's note, and Mrs. Sowerby chats with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) puts a sleepy [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed.
>

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md) Sowerby's death, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) proposes inviting the widowed [Agatha](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) to move into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) so that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) can attend [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) resigns from her teaching position, causing her students great dismay, while she and Isolde discuss the upcoming changes in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley).
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh attend a farewell gathering hosted by the B.V.I.S., where they receive send-off gifts. After feeling discouraged by local opinions about her upcoming college attendance, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes for a walk through the woods with Hugh, finding a wild apple tree and enjoying a quiet walk home along [Linger Lane](../codex/places.md#linger-lane).
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) departs from [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) after emotional goodbyes, traveling by train and ferry alongside Hugh and Wilfred. Upon arriving in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris), she is greeted by [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), who escorts her to their new boardinghouse while chatting to brighten Nell's spirits.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) settle into college life at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), aided by Cressida Lindsay's social influence while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) earns respect as Freshman Class president. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a stack of letters from home containing updates from [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and news from her friends and family, including humorous local stories from Mrs. Sowerby.

Mrs. Sowerby writes about her daily routine and Robin's misbehavior, while Robin's letter shares local news, mischief, and his curious questions.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday, where she is warmly welcomed by Isolde, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), Mrs. Sowerby, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md). Before bed, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) confesses his desire to use a bad word he heard from a hired boy, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gently helps him overcome his conflict. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives letters from [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and Cressida, sharing their news and humorous stories.
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) completes her term at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) while managing persistent suitors, including an unpleasant proposal from [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md). She receives a letter from her friend [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) proposing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) lease a house together for the upcoming school year. After searching without success, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stumble upon a 'To Let' sign on Tabby's Place in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris).
>

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and observes subtle changes around town, including [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) Pullen's marriage and Odette's plan to move West. She learns from Mrs. Sowerby that her friend [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md) is gravely ill with consumption. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde drop off jelly at Aunt Drusilla's home, enduring her unpleasant remarks before continuing on to visit Opal, while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) confides her secret ambition to write a story.
>

> Rebellious over Mrs. Sowerby's strict rules, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) throws away his collection money, forces [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) to skip Sunday School, and goes fishing with the Cotton children instead. After returning home and telling a series of lies to Mrs. Sowerby to cover up his absence, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) is overcome with guilt and tearfully confesses his misdeeds to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) late that night.
>

Following the funeral, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) walk home discussing death and the afterlife.

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends a lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday trapped at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) by severe snowstorms, feeling awkward during visits from Hugh and worrying about her ability to afford her continued studies. Her mood turns around when Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) delivers the mail, including news that [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) has left her a one-thousand-dollar bequest in her will.

> In the orchard at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), Mrs. Agatha, and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) chat about a local funeral, schoolwork, and Isolde's upcoming wedding. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reflects on Hugh Carrow's proposal turning into local gossip, feels anxious about the upcoming changes, and misses Hugh's presence while receiving regular letters from [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

_Sources: [v3 ch.Evening P0](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0000), [v3 ch.Evening P20](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0020), [v3 ch.Evening P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), [v3 ch.Evening P23](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0023)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) helps Isolde dress and prepare for her wedding day at [Pear Hill](../codex/places.md#pear-hill). Following the ceremony and celebration, Hugh accompanies [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on a evening stroll back toward [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), taking a detour down Lovers' Lane to chat about their lives.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Isolde’s Wedding

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P1](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0001), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v3 ch.Wedding P17](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0017)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) feeling melancholic about her broken engagement and lost youth. She visits neighbors and friends, learning about recent local developments, wedding announcements, and births, which heightens her sense of loneliness.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P0](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0000), [v3 ch.Weddings P25](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0025), [v3 ch.Weddings P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 ch.Weddings P51](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0051)_

> At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md) excitedly prepare gifts for Nell's upcoming wedding to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md). Visitors come to congratulate [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), including [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md), Mrs. [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md), and Mrs. Jasper Bell, who offer mixed well-wishes. Later, Hugh visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and they joyfully discuss the historic house in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) he has secured for them to live in.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P0](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P9](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P15](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P20](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0020)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), Captain Saul, and [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) in attendance. During the visit, Miss Winifred and Captain Saul exchange lively, opinionated stories and debates about local gossip, church politics, and historical feuds while Hugh entertains them. After Hugh carefully carves the geese under Nell's instructions, the group enjoys a successful feast and listens to Captain Saul's tales by the fire.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P7](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053)_

> In the kitchen, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reprimands Hugh and Captain Saul for baiting [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) before instructing Hugh to carve the geese. Hugh carves the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) meal successfully, and the group enjoys a festive dinner followed by storytelling by the hearth. Afterward, Captain Saul prepares to head back to the lighthouse and invites [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to visit him.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P48](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P49](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P54](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0054)_

> During a cold winter at [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends time with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and Captain Saul, though she senses an underlying distance and resentment from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) despite their friendship. After [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) reacts bitterly to news of Nell's upcoming child, she later gifts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) a delicately handmade baby gown. Meanwhile, Captain Saul shares his written life log with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who wishes a talented writer like [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) could turn his adventurous life into a book.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P11](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P19](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0019)_

> [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) agrees to write Captain Saul's life story incorporating the tale of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and he spends a glorious summer working on the manuscript at the lighthouse. Along with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), and [Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), Adrian enjoys coastal outings while finishing the novel, which he concludes by September.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P0](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P18](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0018)_

> Miss Winifred and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat over the newspaper obituaries and past parish stories, including a story about an overzealous evangelist named [Fiske](../character/fiske.md). [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) mourns the death of her loyal old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), refusing Nell's offer of a replacement for now. After spending [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh return to [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), where Captain Saul shares news from [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) about his upcoming book publication.
>
